sentences: The source studies counting copies of graph patterns modulo two under parameterized complexity.
It conjectures that any computable pattern class with unbounded matching-split number yields a parity-subgraph problem complete for parity-\(\mathrm{W}[1]\).
The width condition is intended to identify when the pattern structure crosses from manageable cases into parameterized hardness.
A proof would complete a structural classification for modular counting rather than just add one hard pattern family.
The matching-split parameter, reduction notion, and subgraph-counting convention must be taken from the source, since ordinary exact counting and parity counting can behave differently.
